description.value: T-Bones is a BC-based specialty meat and butcher shop with multiple locations, including Vernon, offering a wide selection of fresh and frozen beef, poultry, pork, seafood, lamb, deli items, prepared sides, and house-made sauces. The Vernon location supports online ordering with curbside pickup, making it convenient for cyclists looking to stock up on protein-rich provisions. The deli section includes ready-to-eat items such as roasted potatoes and Greek salad made fresh in-store.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms T-Bones is an active specialty meat and butcher shop with multiple BC locations, including a Vernon pickup location listed in the product categories. The site showcases a broad range of fresh and frozen meats, deli items, prepared foods, and sauces available for online order and in-store pickup — confirming it is open and operational. No cyclist-specific amenity evidence (bike parking, water, washrooms, etc.) appears anywhere in the website content, so those fields remain null.
concerns: OSM tag shop=supermarket is inaccurate — the business is a specialty meat/butcher shop, not a supermarket. The broad 'Groceries' directory category is acceptable, but the OSM tag may warrant correction.
